regions.today: Today will start off cold and mainly dry across Leinster with frost in some areas. Any frost will clear to give a cool, bright day with good sunny spells. A few showers may develop along parts of the east coast. Highest temperatures of 6 to 9 degrees with light to moderate northerly breezes.
regions.tonight: Tonight will be cold with clear spells and a sharp frost in most areas with some icy patches. There’ll be a bit more cloud in the northwest and perhaps a few light showers. Lowest temperatures of -3 to +1 degrees.
regions.tomorrow: Friday will start off cold and frosty with icy patches in places. Frost will gradually clear. It will be mainly dry with bright or sunny spells in the morning. Cloud will increase from the west later in the day. Quite cold with highest temperatures of 6 to 9 degrees and light variable breezes.
